fields.label: Currency
fields.options:
SAR
KWD
USD
ETB
AED
QAR
fields.description: All items in a batch share one currency (taken from the commissions batched in). Birr is used only for internal income/expense accounting, never for the agency-facing invoice.

fields.label: Total (Batch Currency)
fields.description: Sum of the batched commissions in the batch's own currency. This, not the Birr figure, is what drives settlement status and what's shown on the invoice.

fields.label: Total (Birr)
fields.description: Internal accounting figure only -- FX-converted at each commission's accrual date. Not shown on the agency invoice.

fields.label: Requested Advance
fields.description: An up-front amount the agency is asked to pay ASAP when the batch is created, ahead of settling the whole total. In the batch's currency. Informational -- what actually arrives is recorded in Advance Received.

fields.label: Advance Received (Batch Currency)
fields.description: Partial amount actually received from the foreign agency against this batch, in the batch's own currency. Leave 0 for a full settlement. This drives the invoice and settlement status.

fields.label: Advance Received (Birr)
fields.description: Internal accounting figure only -- computed from Advance Received (Batch Currency) at the batch's FX rate. Not shown on the agency invoice.

fields.label: Advance Reference
fields.description: Bank/transfer reference for the advance payment.

fields.label: Write-off / Discount (Batch Currency)
fields.description: Agreed discount the agency doesn't pay, in the batch's own currency (e.g. the $1000 negotiated off a $5000 USD batch). Set via finance_api.write_off_batch. Drives the invoice and settlement status.

fields.label: Write-off / Discount (Birr)
fields.description: Internal accounting figure only -- the Birr amount actually booked on the linked Expense transaction. Not shown on the agency invoice.

fields.label: Balance Due (Batch Currency)
fields.description: Total minus advance received minus write-off, in the batch's own currency. Auto-computed. This is the figure shown on the invoice and used to determine settlement status.

fields.label: Balance Due (Birr)
fields.description: Internal accounting figure only, mirrored from the same item set. Auto-computed.
